name: Chill Medicated | 500mg THC:CBD 1:1 | RELAX Body Rub
description:
Find reliable relief where it matters most. Pain may be inevitable but suffering is not! Chill medicated Body Rub is great for everyday aches and pains, and easy to apply. This topical is non-transdermal, meaning it does not get you high, making it the perfect fit for all day use in any environment.
Apply the balm directly to the affected area, gently massage until completely absorbed. Store the container in cooler temperatures and keep out of direct sunlight.
